name: Boon of Energy Resistance
summary: +1 to any ability (max 30); Resistance to two damage types, and a Reaction to redirect that damage at a foe.

benefits.name: Energy Resistances
benefits.summary: Resistance to two chosen damage types; you can change them when you finish a Long Rest.
benefits.text: You gain Resistance to two of these damage types of your choice: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant or Thunder. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change your choices.

benefits.name: Energy Redirection
benefits.summary: Reaction on taking a chosen type: a creature within 60 ft makes a Dex save or takes 2d12 + Con mod.
benefits.text: When you take damage of one of the types chosen for Energy Resistances, you can take a Reaction to direct damage of the same type at another creature you can see within 60 feet of you that isn't behind Total Cover. That creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Constitution modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or take damage equal to 2d12 plus your Constitution modifier.
